keyVerseDR: "Because my eyes have seen thy salvation," (Lk 2:30)

level1.title: Jesus Is the Light
level1.story: Mary and Joseph brought Baby Jesus to the Temple. Simeon held Him and said, "My eyes have seen the Savior!" He called Jesus a light for all people.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: Why do we bless candles today?
level1.prayer: Jesus, Light of the world, shine in me. Amen.

activity.title: Candlemas candles
activity.intro: Today candles are blessed. Color them for Jesus, the Light!

level2.title: The Presentation in the Temple
level2.story: Forty days after Jesus was born, Mary and Joseph brought Him to the Temple in Jerusalem to present Him to the Lord. They offered a pair of turtledoves, as the law said. Simeon, a just and devout man, took Jesus in his arms and blessed God. He said, "Because my eyes have seen Thy salvation... a light to the revelation of the Gentiles." The prophetess Anna also gave thanks and spoke of Jesus to all who awaited redemption.
level2.keyLine: My eyes have seen thy salvation.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What did Simeon say Jesus would be?
level2.prayer: Lord, let my eyes see Your salvation. Amen.

activity.title: Who am I?
clues: I was a just and devout man in Jerusalem.
God promised I would see the Christ before I died.
I held Baby Jesus in my arms in the Temple.
